tools/simulation/ui/in-playwright-image..name: Browser test container
tools/simulation/ui/in-playwright-image..description: Runs a command inside the same pinned browser-test container that the automatic browser checks use, so local runs match them.

tools/simulation/ui/mutation-check.sh.name: Test-suite sabotage check
tools/simulation/ui/mutation-check.sh.description: Deliberately breaks the app in known ways and confirms the browser tests notice, proving they can really fail.

tools/simulation/ui/playwright.canary.co.name: Speed probe settings
tools/simulation/ui/playwright.canary.co.description: Settings for the speed probe that watches how screens feel while the app is under heavy load.

tools/simulation/ui/playwright.config.ts.name: Browser test settings
tools/simulation/ui/playwright.config.ts.description: Main settings for the click-through tests: which browser, which screen sizes and where the tests live.

tools/simulation/ui/playwright.palettes..name: Colour theme capture settings
tools/simulation/ui/playwright.palettes..description: Settings for the run that photographs screens in each colour theme.

tools/simulation/ui/playwright.screensho.name: Screenshot run settings
tools/simulation/ui/playwright.screensho.description: Settings for the run that captures screenshots of the app for review.

tools/simulation/ui/run-canary.sh.name: Speed probe runner
tools/simulation/ui/run-canary.sh.description: Starts the speed probe against the test farm while load is running and gathers how fast screens appeared.

tools/simulation/ui/specs-canary/canary..name: Speed probe test
tools/simulation/ui/specs-canary/canary..description: Visits key screens as a person would while the app is busy and records how long they take to show up and settle.

tools/simulation/ui/specs-screenshots/pa.name: Colour theme screenshots
tools/simulation/ui/specs-screenshots/pa.description: Captures screens in each colour theme, light and dark, so the looks can be compared.

tools/simulation/ui/specs-screenshots/sc.name: Screen screenshots
tools/simulation/ui/specs-screenshots/sc.description: Captures screenshots of the app screens for use in reviews and documentation.

tools/simulation/ui/specs/a11y-live-regi.name: Screen-reader announcement tests
tools/simulation/ui/specs/a11y-live-regi.description: Checks in a real browser that spoken status messages still reach screen-reader users while a pop-up window is open.

tools/simulation/ui/specs/csp-nonce.spec.name: Security header match tests
tools/simulation/ui/specs/csp-nonce.spec.description: Checks the page and its security rules carry the same one-time code, both online and after reloading offline.

tools/simulation/ui/specs/dashboard-floc.name: Lay rate flock scope tests
tools/simulation/ui/specs/dashboard-floc.description: Checks the dashboard laying-rate card handles flock choice and days with incomplete entries sensibly.

tools/simulation/ui/specs/dashboard-scri.name: Dashboard load time tests
tools/simulation/ui/specs/dashboard-scri.description: Checks the dashboard does not hold up the page with long-running scripts.

tools/simulation/ui/specs/day-readout-pl.name: Day readout placement tests
tools/simulation/ui/specs/day-readout-pl.description: Checks the laying-rate day readout stays in its reserved spot however the mouse or keyboard moves over the chart.

tools/simulation/ui/specs/dialog-actions.name: Expense pop-up tests
tools/simulation/ui/specs/dialog-actions.description: Checks the Save button stays reachable when correcting an expense, on desktop and phone sizes.

tools/simulation/ui/specs/expanded-chart.name: Expanded chart fit tests
tools/simulation/ui/specs/expanded-chart.description: Checks the enlarged laying-rate chart stretches a short date range to fit and scrolls a long one.

tools/simulation/ui/specs/expanded-chart.name: Expanded chart focus tests
tools/simulation/ui/specs/expanded-chart.description: Checks the enlarged laying-rate chart behaves like a pop-up window for keyboard and screen-reader users.

tools/simulation/ui/specs/expanded-range.name: Expanded chart date field tests
tools/simulation/ui/specs/expanded-range.description: Checks the custom date fields on the enlarged laying-rate chart fit and work at phone width.

tools/simulation/ui/specs/i18n.spec.ts.name: Language display tests
tools/simulation/ui/specs/i18n.spec.ts.description: Checks the Spanish and Tagalog versions of the screens display without breaking.

tools/simulation/ui/specs/inspector-focu.name: Archive focus tests
tools/simulation/ui/specs/inspector-focu.description: Checks that after archiving a flock from its side panel, keyboard focus lands on the nearest remaining flock.

tools/simulation/ui/specs/inspector-layo.name: Side panel layout tests
tools/simulation/ui/specs/inspector-layo.description: Checks the side panel actions for users, customers, grades, flocks and products lay out and colour correctly in each theme.

tools/simulation/ui/specs/ledger-theme.s.name: Ledger theme tests
tools/simulation/ui/specs/ledger-theme.s.description: Checks the field console ledger rows, links and headings follow the shared light and dark themes.

tools/simulation/ui/specs/manager.spec.t.name: Manager walkthrough tests
tools/simulation/ui/specs/manager.spec.t.description: Plays a manager: submits a daily entry, reviews it, adjusts or voids it, and works with flocks.

tools/simulation/ui/specs/named-entity-p.name: Flock and customer picker tests
tools/simulation/ui/specs/named-entity-p.description: Checks the searchable flock and customer pickers find, page through and select the right record.

tools/simulation/ui/specs/optical-size.s.name: Font sizing tests
tools/simulation/ui/specs/optical-size.s.description: Checks the browser really switches the font between its large and small cuts as designed.

tools/simulation/ui/specs/owner.spec.ts.name: Owner walkthrough tests
tools/simulation/ui/specs/owner.spec.ts.description: Plays the owner: opens the dashboard, runs reports, browses the audit trail and downloads an export.

tools/simulation/ui/specs/pagination.spe.name: Long list paging tests
tools/simulation/ui/specs/pagination.spe.description: Checks lists with more records than fit on one page can be paged through without losing any.

tools/simulation/ui/specs/phone.spec.ts.name: Phone layout tests
tools/simulation/ui/specs/phone.spec.ts.description: Checks the phone version of the app (screens under 900 pixels wide): menu, sheets and layout behave correctly.

tools/simulation/ui/specs/pwa.spec.ts.name: Installable app tests
tools/simulation/ui/specs/pwa.spec.ts.description: Checks the app can be installed and keeps working offline in a real browser.

tools/simulation/ui/specs/readonly.spec..name: Read-only user tests
tools/simulation/ui/specs/readonly.spec..description: Plays a read-only user: browsing works, and deep links to screens they may not see are refused.

tools/simulation/ui/specs/reports-range..name: Report date range tests
tools/simulation/ui/specs/reports-range..description: Checks a report still works at the longest date range it supports.

tools/simulation/ui/specs/sales-layout.s.name: Orders layout tests
tools/simulation/ui/specs/sales-layout.s.description: Checks how the orders list opens an order on phone and desktop sizes.

tools/simulation/ui/specs/sales.spec.ts.name: Sales walkthrough tests
tools/simulation/ui/specs/sales.spec.ts.description: Plays a sales user end to end: add a customer, draft an order, add lines, confirm it and record a payment.

tools/simulation/ui/specs/session-races..name: Sign-in timing tests
tools/simulation/ui/specs/session-races..description: Checks that signing in and out at the same moment in several tabs never leaves someone wrongly signed in.

tools/simulation/ui/specs/session-refres.name: Staying signed in tests
tools/simulation/ui/specs/session-refres.description: Checks sign-in works and the session quietly renews itself past the 15-minute mark.

tools/simulation/ui/specs/setup-lists-st.name: Sticky table header tests
tools/simulation/ui/specs/setup-lists-st.description: Checks the Flocks table header stays pinned while the rows scroll beneath it.

tools/simulation/ui/specs/table-cell-fir.name: Table spacing tests
tools/simulation/ui/specs/table-cell-fir.description: Checks the first column of tables is not pressed against the edge.

tools/simulation/ui/specs/two-factor.spe.name: Two-step sign-in tests
tools/simulation/ui/specs/two-factor.spe.description: Checks an owner with two-step sign-in enters the code and still lands on the page they asked for.

tools/simulation/ui/specs/users-actions-.name: Users table fit tests
tools/simulation/ui/specs/users-actions-.description: Checks the users table fits every supported screen size, theme and language.
